chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus ibn Yaqoub, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'I prayed the prescribed prayer but forgot to recite in my prayer, all of it.' So he (peace be upon him) said, 'Is it not so that you had completed the bowing and the prostration?' I said, 'Yes.' He (peace be upon him) said, 'Your prayer is complete, when it was out of forgetfulness.'
ai.seo_question: Is my prayer valid if I forgot to recite the Quran during it?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Mansur ibn Hazim inquires about the validity of his prayer after forgetting the Quranic recitation (*Qira'ah*) entirely. Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) affirms its validity, establishing that the omission of recitation due to forgetfulness (*nisyan*) does not nullify the prayer, provided the essential pillars of bowing (*ruku'*) and prostration (*sujud*) are completed. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that minor omissions during prayer, when caused by forgetfulness, do not require compensation (*qada*) or invalidation, distinguishing them from intentional neglect.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus Bin Yaqoub, from Mansour Bin Hazim who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘I prayed the Prescribed Salāt, but I forgot to recite in my Salāt, all of it’. So heasws said: ‘Is it no so that you had completed the Rukū and the Sajdah?’ I said, ‘Yes’. Heasws said: ‘You have completed your Salāt, when it was out of forgetfulness’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya‘qub from Mansur ibn Hazim who has said the following: “

I once said to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I performed the obligatory Salah (prayer) but forgot the recitation in all of my Salah (prayer). He (the Imam) asked, ‘Did you complete Ruku‘ (bowing down on one’s knees) and Sujud (prostrations)?’ I replied, ‘Yes, I did so.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Your Salah (prayer) is complete if it was because of forgetfulness.’”
